title: Heart of Many Faces
description: A large dripping purple heart dominates the center, containing multiple women's faces with closed eyes intertwined with flowing rainbow-colored hair. Two hands reach toward each other from below: one is a wooden mannequin hand, the other wears a delicate white lace glove. The background features surreal rainbow spirals, additional floating female faces, and two full wooden mannequins standing behind the central composition.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene featuring a large melting purple heart in the center containing multiple women's faces with closed eyes and intricate facial markings, their hair flowing as vibrant rainbow spirals. A wooden mannequin hand and a hand in a white lace glove reach toward each other from the bottom. Background shows additional floating female faces and full wooden mannequins amid swirling rainbow patterns and light rays from above, in a dreamlike symbolic composition.
